UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Registered InputBench player profile with unique username and explicit policy agreement consent.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Public display username chosen by the user.

usernameLower.description: Lowercase canonical username used for uniqueness locking.

agreedToPolicy.description: Must be true confirming the user ticked and accepted the InputBench Policy Agreements.

policyVersion.description: Version identifier of the accepted policy agreements.

policyAgreedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest policy agreement confirmation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was last updated.

banned.description: True if the account has been permanently locked for hacking/exploits or policy violations.

banReason.description: Reason for account ban (e.g. hacking/exploits or policy violation).

banMessage.description: Message displayed on the ban lock screen (e.g. nice try).

bannedAt.description: Server timestamp when the ban was enforced.

banVersion.description: Security shield revision that issued the ban (e.g. v2).

IpBan.title: IpBan
IpBan.description: Hashed IP ban record locked in Firestore to persist hacking/exploits and policy violation bans.

ipHash.description: SHA-256 HMAC hash of the client IP address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID active when the ban was triggered.

reason.description: Ban reason (e.g. hacking/exploits or Policy violation).

banVersion.description: Security shield revision that issued the IP ban.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the IP ban was recorded.

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Public uniqueness lock mapping a lowercase username to its owning Firebase Auth UID without exposing PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID claiming this username.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was claimed.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A player's verified global personal-best score entry for a specific InputBench game and mode/difficulty board.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who owns this score entry.

displayName.description: Public player username displayed on the global leaderboard.

boardKey.description: Board identifier combining game and difficulty/mode (e.g., cps_5s, wave_hard).

score.description: Numeric primary metric used for global sorting (>= 0).

scoreLabel.description: Formatted primary score readout (e.g., 12.45 CPS, 118 WPM, 184 ms).

detailText.description: Secondary run breakdown text (accuracy, clicks, obstacles, streak).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player first posted to this board.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player last improved their score or profile on this board.

ParentalControlConfig.title: ParentalControlConfig
ParentalControlConfig.description: Server-enforced Parental Controls configuration keyed by Firebase Auth UID, protecting minors with PIN locks, age-tier rules, safe preset chat enforcement, and custom media upload restrictions.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

ageTier.description: Account safety tier governing default and maximum allowed chat/social permissions.

chatMode.description: Chat restriction mode enforced in Firestore security rules.

allowFriendRequests.description: Whether friend requests can be sent to or from this account.

requireParentApproval.description: When true, sending or accepting friend requests requires entering the Parent PIN.

blockPiiAndLinks.description: Blocks URLs, phone numbers, emails, off-platform social handles, and grooming solicitation phrases.

allowCustomMedia.description: Whether local custom image/GIF/audio uploads are permitted on this account.

parentPinEnabled.description: Whether a Parent PIN protects Parental Controls from being changed.

pinHash.description: Salted SHA-256 hex digest of the Parent PIN when parentPinEnabled is true.

blockedAttemptsCount.description: Count of unsafe/blocked chat or grooming attempts intercepted for parent visibility.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when parental controls were initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when parental controls were last modified.

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: Canonical bidirectional friend relationship between two InputBench players keyed by sorted UID pair.

participants.description: Sorted two-element tuple of Firebase Auth UIDs.

participantUsernames.description: Map of UID to display username for each participant.

requestedBy.description: UID of the player who initiated the friend request.

blockedBy.description: UID of the participant who blocked the relationship, if status is blocked.

lastMessageAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest chat message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the friendship record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the friendship record was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Immutable 1-on-1 friend chat message scoped under an accepted friendship.

participants.description: Denormalized sorted pair of UIDs matching the parent friendship for secure queries without extra reads.

kind.description: Whether the message is a server-allowlisted safe preset or filtered free text.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent.

SafetyReport.title: SafetyReport
SafetyReport.description: Immutable safety incident report submitted by a user or parent for grooming, off-platform luring, explicit content, or abuse.

reporterUid.description: UID of the user filing the safety report.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was submitted.

/accounts/{uid}.description: User account records storing username, policy agreement consent, and ban enforcement state keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/ipBans/{ipHash}.description: Hashed IP ban registry blocking hacking/exploits and policy violation clients.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Username uniqueness registry preventing duplicate usernames across accounts.

/leaderboards/{boardKey}/entries/{entryI.description: Global leaderboard personal-best entries partitioned by boardKey and keyed by player uid.

/parentalControls/{uid}.description: Private Parental Controls settings and salted Parent PIN hash keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/friendships/{pairId}.description: Canonical friend request, accepted friend, and blocked relationship records.

/friendships/{pairId}/messages/{messageI.description: Immutable 1-on-1 chat messages scoped strictly to accepted friends.

/safetyReports/{reportId}.description: Immutable safety and anti-grooming reports filed by users or parents.
